threats.description: Direct, explicit threats of violence or admissions of intent to commit violence (high-confidence patterns).
threats.recommended_action: High priority review; likely grounds for enforcement.

sexual_minors.description: Explicit sexual content that references minors or underage persons (high-confidence).
sexual_minors.recommended_action: Immediate review and escalation; severe policy violation.

doxxing.description: Sharing of private/personal data (email, phone, IP, street address). These patterns are high-confidence indicators of doxxing when seen in context.
doxxing.recommended_action: Immediate removal and escalation; privacy breach risk.

illegal_activity.description: Explicit instructions or facilitation of violent or other illegal activities (weapons, explosives, drug production/purchase).

hate_speech_violent.description: Hateful content that includes calls for violence or mass harm against a group (high-confidence).

phishing_scam.description: High-confidence phishing/scam indicators (fake Nitro/Discord gift pages, shorteners with typical scam language).
sample_triggers: Claim your free giftcard here: bit.ly/abc
phishing_scam.recommended_action: Remove and escalate; phishing/scams may lead to account action.
